description: Attacks a known vulnerability in a service or application.
Feeds random/malformed input to crash a service.
A block-cipher based attack effective against any cipher; an UNSW category, not a catch-all.
Scans and probes hosts to map services.
Floods a single target to deny service.
Injects a small payload that opens a shell.
Probes web / HTML / port surfaces for weaknesses.
Self-replicating malware that spreads between hosts.
